interventions.title: Vertical Delineation
interventions.description: Use bollards or planters to physically separate the pedestrian walkway from the vehicle maneuvering area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks and Pedestrian Signals
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with HAWK signals or standard traffic signals to provide safe crossing opportunities.

interventions.title: Continuous Separated Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct a continuous, ADA-compliant sidewalk on both sides of the street, physically separated from the roadway and parking areas.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the roadway to increase physical separation.

interventions.title: Driveway Consolidation
interventions.description: Reduce the width of the gas station access points to specific, narrow driveways to minimize the conflict zone.

interventions.title: Continuous Raised Sidewalk
interventions.description: Extend a clearly defined, raised sidewalk across the gas station frontage to give pedestrians priority and visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Buffer and Bollards
interventions.description: Install a landscape buffer or bollards to physically separate the pedestrian walkway from the vehicle maneuvering area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffering
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer or furniture zone between the sidewalk and the curb to increase pedestrian comfort and safety.
